entities.name: Query ATP synthase alpha
observations: 501 aa bacterial protein; predicted molecular mass 54.37 kDa and theoretical pI 4.85.
Exact full-length sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt P95787, annotated as ATP synthase subunit alpha from Streptococcus mutans.
Pfam domains: ATP-synt_ab_N PF02874 at residues 26-92, ATP-synt_ab PF00006 at 149-364, and ATP-synt_ab_C PF00306 at 371-492.
Conserved architecture supports the F1-sector ATP synthase alpha subunit; no transmembrane segment is expected for this peripheral catalytic-complex component.

entities.name: ATP synthase alpha subunit
observations: The alpha subunit is a noncatalytic/regulatory nucleotide-binding component of the F1 sector that alternates with beta subunits in an alpha3-beta3 ring.
It participates in proton-gradient-driven ATP synthesis as part of the membrane-associated F-type ATP synthase complex; the membrane-spanning proton channel is formed by other subunits.
Reviewed homolog annotations include ATP/ADP binding, proton-transporting ATP synthase complex membership, and rotational-mechanism ATP synthase activity at the complex level.

entities.name: F-type ATP synthase reaction
observations: Annotated overall complex reaction: ATP + H2O + 4 H+ (in) = ADP + phosphate + 5 H+ (out), Rhea RHEA:57720.
The reaction describes the ATP synthase complex and should not be interpreted as alpha-subunit catalysis alone.
